hits.title: Cornerstone Advisors appoints Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman.
hits.snippet: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., August 4, 2026 - Cornerstone Advisors ("Cornerstone"), a leading management and technology consultancy serving banks, credit unions, and fintechs, today announced the appointment of Mazen Ghalayini as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman.
